{{Quote|The old order is dead. Long live the new order.|Callef|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
'''Callef''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The apprentice of [[Bengel Morr]], Callef and his master rallied the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the early stages of the [[Flesh Raider uprising]], he led his Flesh Raider [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in an [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attack]] on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Gnarls Outpost|base]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], and captured a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] by the name of [[Unaw Aharo]]. However, Callef was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|duel]] with another [[Hero of Tython|Jedi apprentice]] who came to rescue Aharo.

==Biography==
{{Quote|&laquo;He commands the Flesh Raiders attacking us.&raquo;<br />''"''Not attacking&mdash;cleansing. And we have only begun.|quotestart=0|Unaw Aharo and Callef, to the Padawan who rescued Aharo|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Callef became the apprentice of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]]<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> sometime before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> Morr, the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] apprentice of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], had disappeared during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="The Face of the Enemy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Face of the Enemy|Tython}}</ref> and he had gone insane over the course of the next ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Morr taught Callef that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had become weak and useless, and that it should be destroyed and rebuilt into something stronger.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Callef and Morr made their move on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. In their quest to overthrow the Jedi Order, he and his master instigated an [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]] amongst the native [[Flesh Raider]]s, and used the bestial natives as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] while they directed from the shadows. Using a secret tunnel connecting the [[Tythos Ridge]] and the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], Callef led an invasion force of Flesh Raiders into the Gnarls against the Jedi's base there. A [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] by the name of [[Unaw Aharo]] had noticed the increased Flesh Raider activity in the area and reported his findings to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Derrin Weller]]. However, Aharo was captured by Callef's forces not long after sending his message, and they brought the wounded and disarmed Bith before the Dark Jedi in the cave.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

{{GameLS}}
[[File:Callef_and_Aharo.png|thumb|200|left|Callef beats up Unaw Aharo.]]
Callef began to question Aharo, who was shocked to see that the Human carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. However, a [[Hero of Tython|young Padawan]] interrupted Callef before he could kill the Bith, having defeated the Flesh Raider soldiers who had been guarding the cave. The Jedi apprentice's martial skill sparked the Dark Jedi's interest, but Callef was confident in his abilities and summoned two Flesh Raider guards, attacking the Padawan. Despite having only a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] against the Dark Jedi's lightsaber, the apprentice fought and defeated Callef in a [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|duel]], which ended with Callef's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

===Legacy===
After his death, Master [[Orgus Din]] arrived and sealed the cave after he recovered Callef's lightsaber. Remarking on the strange familiarity of the weapon, Din escorted Aharo to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] and ordered the other Padawan to report to the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Later on, the Padawan would be contacted by Callef's master [[Bengel Morr]], who expressed his disappointment that Callef was defeated so easily. However, Morr was not overly concerned, as he doubted the Padawan would be able to defeat him and stop the Flesh Raider invasion.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&laquo;You are Jedi. Why would you kill me?&raquo;<br />''"''Because the order must evolve&mdash;and you are weak.|quotestart=0|Unaw Aharo and Callef|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
[[File:Callef_saber.png|thumb|right|150px|Callef's lightsaber]]
A Force-sensitive Human male, the fair-skinned Callef had [[Color/Legends|black]] hair and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and able to understand [[Bith (language)/Legends|the language of the Bith people]], as well as the guttural language of the Flesh Raiders. Callef was arrogant and cruel, believing in survival of the fittest, and he despised what he saw as passivity and weakness on the part of the Jedi Order. Like his master Bengel Morr, Callef desired the destruction of the Jedi Order so that the pair could rebuild it in accordance with their own beliefs.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> The Padawan who killed Callef later remarked to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] that Callef seemed calm&mdash;the apprentice could feel no anger or fear in the Dark Jedi, despite his use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="High-Tech Savages">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|High-Tech Savages|Tython}}</ref>

As Bengel Morr's apprentice, Callef wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber that he based on his master's own weapon. When Orgus Din&mdash;Morr's former master&mdash;recovered Callef's saber from the Dark Jedi's body, he was startled by the weapon's familiarity, though he could not remember that of which it reminded him.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Behind the scenes==
Callef was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> He is the first boss fought by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] character, as part of the player's first class quest "Attack of the Flesh Raiders." Players can choose to attack Callef in the middle of their conversation for dark side points, or ask for Callef's surrender for light-side points. As the Jedi Knight is a Republic character, it is assumed that the Knight chooses only light-side options.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> As part of an April Fool's joke in 2011, several cinematics from the game were released on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website with vocalization in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]], the language of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species. One of the videos showed the events of the mission "Weapon of the Jedi," in which players confront Bengel Morr, but the video showed Callef in Morr's place.<ref name="April">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20110401|text=Shyriiwook Localization}}</ref>
